boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's wm_system.c, 0x0206116c..0x020618b8: 10 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. Every body compiles byte-identical with the signatures, locals and statements of ntrtwl/NitroSDK libraries/wm/src/wm_system.c, in this older SDK's shape: WM_Init carves the system buffer itself (no WmInitCore, no WMi_InitForScan, no interrupt lock), WM_SendCommand takes its FIFO block from bufMsgQ with OS_ReceiveMessage and, for a command with no parameters, sends a DMA copy of the command block its caller filled in, and WmReceiveFifo keeps no connected-AID bitmap.

Order: mwccarm emits the bodies in reverse. The SDK file's order (WM_Init, WM_Finish, WM_SetCallbackTable, WM_SendCommand, WM_GetSystemWork, WMi_CheckInitialized, WMi_CheckIdle, WM_CheckStateEx, WmReceiveFifo, WmClearFifoRecvFlag) is the ROM's order reversed.
BSS: 0x020a89a8..0x020a9440 holds the file's six statics, and only functions in this run reference them (config/arm9/relocs.txt). WM_Etc.c's tmpUserGameInfoBuf follows at 0x020a9440.
BOTTOM EDGE: CARD_PullOut.cpp's run ends at 0x0206116c. TOP EDGE: the wm_sync.c run (src/engine/wm/WM_Sync.c) starts at 0x020618b8.

bss.evidence: The SDK's `static u16 wmInitialized`: WM_Init sets it, WM_Finish clears it, WMi_CheckInitialized tests it (u16, padded to the next word).
The SDK's `static WMArm9Buf *wm9buf`, the system buffer WM_Init carves; every function here reads it, WM_GetSystemWork hands it out.
The SDK's `static OSMessageQueue bufMsgQ` (0x14 in this SDK's OS) of free FIFO blocks: WM_Init fills it, WM_SendCommand takes a block and gives it back.
The SDK's `static OSMessage bufMsg[WM_BUF_MSG_NUM]`, bufMsgQ's ten slots.

WmReceiveFifo's function-local `static WMPortRecvCallback cb_Port` (its compiler spelling, cb_Port$168, as TP_Init's initial$180 is named), the record it passes every port callback on a CONNECTED or DISCONNECTED notice. data_020a8a00 keeps its address name: it is &cb_Port.macAddress (+0x14), the MIi_CpuCopy16 destination WmReceiveFifo's literal pool names, and dsd needs a symbol at every relocation target.
The SDK's `static u32 fifoBuf[WM_BUF_MSG_NUM][WM_FIFO_BUF_SIZE / sizeof(u32)] ATTRIBUTE_ALIGN(32)`, the ten 0x100-byte FIFO blocks WM_Init queues in bufMsgQ.

Built as C, like the SDK and the other wm folds. The prototypes are in include/nitro/wm/wm_api.h (WM_Init, WM_Finish) and include/private/wm_views.h (the SDK-private calls). The statics are file-static, as in the SDK, and the TU builds as an intact object (the FS_File precedent): the binding rewrites publish them global for symbols.txt.
No stdarg.h is in the tree, so WM_SendCommand and WM_CheckStateEx walk their variable arguments with va_arg's expansion written out.
